refreshToken.title: Sensi Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Paste the refresh token obtained from Emerson Sensi. See Readme.md for instructions

deviceId.title: Sensi Device ID
deviceId.description: The device identifier (looks like 'FL33T-yourusername-1234567890') seen in the token request URL in your browser's dev tools when logging in at manager.sensicomfort.com. As of Sensi app v8.6.3+, the WebSocket session appears to validate against this identifier, so connections may be silently rejected without it.
